Dear Ralph Lindner,
thank you for contacting Siemens eMobility Technical Support.

Please wait till you get the offical reply from us and do not reply to this email, since it will not be monitored
If you are reporting an incident from  charger operating  at a Siemens location, you will not be notified futher. The incident will be forwarded to the Siemens location manager.
The reported incident is for charger type:
SiCharge D

170002835

eMobility Technical Support Team

vielen Dank dass Sie sich bei Siemens eMobility Technical Support gemeldet haben.

Bitte warten Sie auf die offizielle Ticket Antwort und antworten Sie nicht auf diese E-Mail. Diese Mailbox wird nicht überwacht.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0431460-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R0 170002835] Communication error CRM:02699000132
additional_info.body:
Dear Ralph Lindner,
I hope this message finds you well.
Following a thorough analysis of the charger logs, I would like to confirm that there are no communication errors currently present. The charger is functioning normally and is in a healthy state, with all outlets available and ready for charging.
We did observe a
temporary issue
yesterday involving one of the outlet.
I wanted to inform you that charger outlets were temporarily unavailable due to a COAP error, The issue has been resolved within a 5 sec.
At this time, there are no active faults or warnings, and the system is operating as expected.
Please feel free to reach out if you have any further questions or require additional details
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita
Please do not
change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.
